page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-4-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. The instance comes equipped with a single local NVMe SSD providing 403 GB of high-speed local storage. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

The hardware profile balances a high memory allocation with dedicated compute resources and fast local storage. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring more memory per core than standard general-purpose instances, without transitioning to massive, multi-core memory-optimized nodes. The inclusion of a 403 GB NVMe SSD provides low-latency scratch space or caching capacity, though users must manage the ephemeral nature of local SSD storage. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Due to its memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated local NVMe storage, this server type is suited for memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, small-scale relational databases, and localized data processing tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance for workloads that cannot tolerate the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances.
